jobs.title: Campaign Operations & Delivery Lead - Joybuy
jobs.description:
**About Joybuy**

Joybuy is JD.com's European online retail business, bringing JD.com's extensive retail, technology and supply chain expertise to European consumers.

Operating through both 1P and 3P business models, Joybuy combines its own retail operations with a growing marketplace ecosystem, offering consumers a broad selection of products from leading international, European and local brands.

Currently operating across the UK, Germany, France, the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg, Joybuy is continuing to expand its European footprint, with plans to enter Spain, Portugal and Italy in 2027.

Supported by JD.com's extensive supply chain capabilities, local warehousing and delivery infrastructure, Joybuy is committed to providing European consumers with quality products, competitive prices and a convenient shopping experience.

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for a commercially driven European Campaign Lead to take ownership of Joybuy's biggest shopping events, including Black Friday, Christmas and Summer Sales.

This is a high-impact role at the intersection of merchandising, marketing and commercial operations. You will lead campaign planning and execution across multiple European markets, bringing cross-functional teams together to deliver strong commercial results.

You will act as both a strategic campaign owner and hands-on operator, with direct accountability for campaign sales performance across four or more European markets.

**Key Responsibilities**

* End-to-End Campaign Ownership: Lead the planning, coordination and execution of major campaigns, from initial briefing and strategy development to implementation and post-campaign performance reviews.
* Commercial & Merchandising Strategy: Work closely with merchandising, cross-border procurement and country operations teams to drive product selection, inventory planning, pricing strategies and promotional mechanics.
* Promotional Strategy: Develop and implement effective promotional frameworks, including coupon structures, bundle deals, flash sales and tiered discounts, ensuring clear commercial objectives and ROI logic.
* Multi-Market Coordination: Drive campaign execution across the UK, Germany, France and the Netherlands, while adapting strategies to local market dynamics and consumer behaviours.
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the central PMO for campaign delivery, aligning stakeholders, tracking milestones, identifying blockers and driving timely decision-making.
* Sales Performance Ownership: Take direct accountability for campaign sales targets, monitor performance against objectives and proactively drive actions to maximise commercial results.

**Requirements**

* 8–12 years of experience in e-commerce operations, campaign management, commercial planning or a related field.
* Strong understanding of e-commerce business fundamentals, including merchandising, product selection, pricing, promotions and inventory management.
* Proven track record of planning and delivering large-scale e-commerce campaigns end-to-end.
* Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to translate campaign strategies into measurable business results.
* Demonstrated ownership mindset, taking accountability for outcomes rather than focusing solely on process coordination.
* Comfortable leveraging AI tools to improve productivity, data analysis and operational efficiency.
* Fluent in English and proficient in Chinese, with the ability to communicate effectively with HQ and China-based teams.
* Previous experience within an e-commerce platform or marketplace is highly preferred.

**Why Join Joybuy?**

* Build Something at Scale: Be part of JD.com's ambitious expansion in Europe and help shape the future of its online retail and marketplace business.
* Real Business Ownership: Take direct ownership of major European campaigns and their commercial performance.
* International Exposure: Work closely with cross-functional teams across Europe and China, operating in a truly international environment.
* High Business Impact: Play a key role in driving Joybuy's growth, customer acquisition and sales performance across multiple European markets.
* Growth Opportunities: Join a rapidly expanding business with further European market launches planned for 2027.

As Communications and Engagement Manager, you will support a high-profile Government programme to establish a new statutory regulatory framework for senior hospital leaders in England, strengthening public trust and confidence in NHS leadership.
  
  
You will work closely with the HCPC executive leadership team and senior leaders across government, the NHS and the wider regulatory landscape, you will operate at the heart of a politically sensitive and highly scrutinised programme of national importance. Therefore, the postholder will need to possess excellent communication and influencing skills as well as a working knowledge of the political and regulatory landscape.
  
This is a demanding, complex and fast paced role, that will come with challenges, however the opportunity will give the postholder to make a real difference by helping to protect the public and shape a landmark reform with lasting impact and tangible results.

* Develop and deliver communication and engagement plan for the implementation of NHS Managers regulation.

* Support consultation and engagement exercises associated with NHS Managers regulation. Assist with monitoring political, sector and policy developments relevant to programme activity.

Further information on this role is detailed in the Job Description and Person Specification (click to download).

jobs.description:
The Growth Marketing Executive – Retail supports the Senior Marketing Business Partner and Product Marketing Manager by coordinating and delivering demand-generation and lifecycle campaigns across the 9 brands in the Retail vertical — turning the vertical's plans into live, optimised, well-measured activity.

It's a hands-on, data-driven role at the heart of how the vertical gets work done: coordinating the campaign calendar, briefing and managing assets through the central engine, shepherding deliverables through review and approval, and turning performance data into clear reporting and recommendations the wider team can act on. You'll draw on ClearCourse's central marketing engine — a shared team, template library and AI-assisted production — to deliver at pace and scale.

**Key Accountabilities:**
-------------------------

**Campaign Coordination & Delivery:**

* Coordinate and deliver multi-channel acquisition and lifecycle campaigns (email, paid, web, social, organic) across the vertical's brands, against the plan set by the Senior Marketing Business Partner.
* Own the day-to-day running of the campaign calendar for your brands — keeping activity on schedule, dependencies tracked and stakeholders informed.
* Focus effort where the commercial opportunity is greatest, in line with the vertical's priorities and brand tiers.
* Create select marketing assets directly, without drawing on centralised resources, through our self-serve system, where images and copy can be created by the Product Marketing Team using pre-approved templates.

**Briefing & Asset Management:**

* Write clear, complete campaign and creative briefs using the agreed template, so work enters production right first time.
* Produce standard assets using the central template library and self-serve tools, and brief the central content, design and channel teams for anything non-standard.
* Manage assets through to delivery — tracking versions, keeping the brand's asset library and campaign records organised, and making sure the right, on-brand assets are used.

**Deliverable Review & Approvals:**

* Manage deliverables through the review process — checking work against the brief for quality, accuracy and brand consistency before it progresses.
* Obtain the necessary sign-offs (SMBP, and Product Director where required) and keep brief and approval status up to date, so nothing goes live unapproved.
* Keep delivery moving — chase inputs, unblock hold-ups and flag slippage early.

**Data, Analytics & Reporting:**

* Set up tracking and manage lead capture and routing, keeping data clean and reliable for accurate reporting.
* Prepare regular campaign and performance reports — clear, accurate and on time — for the SMBP and the wider vertical team.
* Turn the numbers into insight: spot what's working and what isn't, and proactively share findings and recommendations with the team.
* Make data-led suggestions for optimisation — budget, targeting, channel mix, messaging and creative — and help put the agreed changes into action.
* Support demand-generation programmes — nurture flows, lead scoring and campaign automation — and run A/B tests to improve ROAS and conversion.

**Collaboration:**

* Work closely with the central content, creative, martech and analytics functions, and support clean lead hand-off to sales / SDRs.

  
**Requirements**  

* Experience delivering B2B (or B2B2C) marketing campaigns across multiple channels — paid, organic, email or similar.
* Genuinely data-driven — confident pulling, reading and reporting on performance data, and turning it into clear insight and recommendations.
* Hands-on demand-generation, growth or digital marketing execution.
* Comfortable using AI — Claude in particular — as part of everyday work, applying it across most marketing workflows (drafting, research, analysis, reporting and campaign production) to work faster and better.
* Strong coordination and organisation — able to run a busy, multi-brand campaign calendar and keep briefs, assets and approvals on track.
* Clear briefing and communication skills, and an eye for quality and brand consistency when reviewing deliverables.
* Familiarity with paid platforms (Google / Meta / LinkedIn), email tools and GA4 (or similar analytics) is advantageous.
* Experience marketing SaaS or technology products is advantageous; retail software (EPOS, ecommerce, retail management) experience is a big plus, but not essential.
* Exposure to AI marketing tools is a plus.

Because great work deserves great rewards. Here’s what’s in it for you:

* Competitive base salary
* 25 days holiday, plus bank holidays and your birthday off
* Private medical cover
* Health cash plan
* Life assurance
* Access to the Calm wellbeing app
* Perkbox employee benefits platform
* Enhanced parental leave
* Cycle to work scheme
* Volunteering days
